name: Java Memory Model
description: Formalised in JSR-133. Defines happens-before (HB) based on synchronisation actions. Provides DRF-SC guarantee. Known for complexities around causality and out-of-thin-air values.

catSupport.note: The JMM validates an execution only relative to a *sequence* of committing executions. cat's verdict is a predicate on one candidate execution, so the commit-sequence quantifier is outside the language.
